notes.title: Update notes for 05/03
notes.content:
- Experimenting with an easier "Easy Mode" with no industry

notes.title: Update notes for 01/03
notes.content:
Mostly small changes based on some of the feedback
- Added zoom control
- More explicit game over message when running out of money to understand expenses better
- Some fixes around the tutorial

notes.title: Update notes for 28/02
notes.content:
- Monthly costs reduced in easy mode to offer a more accessible first challenge. It will now be a bit harder to go bankrupt early

Let us know if you have any further feedback about the game!
